name: AI Meter
description:
Shows your Claude Pro/Max usage (5-hour window and weekly limits) in the top bar, with a detail panel on click.

It reuses the login of Claude Code on this machine, so no API key is needed: it reads the access token in ~/.claude/.credentials.json and sends it only to api.anthropic.com, to the usage endpoint behind Claude Code's /usage command. Nothing is written back and nothing is sent anywhere else.

Not affiliated with Anthropic.
